request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ada total, consisting of 525,000 ada for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ada Intersect budget administration fee.
The maintainer funding is described as 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.

Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes multiple query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C unix socket.
The proposal states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors, with the GitHub repository provided as a reference.
Dolos is presented as an open-source alternative for querying Cardano chain data without running a full node, intended to remain reliable and performant as developer adoption grows.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved framework.
The proposal asserts the withdrawal does not, at submission, individually or in aggregate breach the 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being handled through Intersect, third parties, and the Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework.

TxPipe is said to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus prior Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

The document provides treasury management smart contract stake and payment addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, an oversight committee list, and dashboard/reference links for auditing the withdrawn funds.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ada through Intersect to fund a 12-month continuation of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe, with stated open-source, developer-infrastructure, oversight, smart-contract custody, and Intersect budget-process justifications.
